about: Kill reputation the Classic database (cmangos 1.12) lacks or gets wrong for Classic Era, by hand, each entry with its source (the user's call, 23 October 2026). Loaded after creature_onkill_reputation, both games: an add is a row of its own (source guides), a cap rewrites the last standing a faction's kills still count at. max_standing as kill_reputation's: 0 Hated .. 7 Exalted, counted while yours is at most this.

add.why: The Syndicate's humanoids (faction template 87, Alterac, Hillsbrad and Arathi) raise Ravenholdt, 1 to 5 a kill by the character's level (5 the most), from Neutral to Friendly. Past Friendly only the junkbox turn-in counts. The cmangos dump has no row for any of them.
add.source: the Classic Ravenholdt reference and guides (classicdb.ch faction 349, warcraft.wiki.gg Syndicate talk page), read 23 October 2026; unverified in game

caps.why: Killing Booty Bay's people raises the Bloodsail Buccaneers to Friendly and no further: by normal means the climb ends at Friendly (the admiral's hat). cmangos lets the kills count through Honored.
caps.source: the Warcraft Tavern Bloodsail Buccaneers reputation guide, read 23 October 2026; unverified in game
